ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, with a fish labeled “Brown trout” at the top, and a box labeled “Dragonfly nymph” near the center. A green arrow points upward from “Dragonfly nymph” to “Brown trout”. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate the direction of energy flow, that is, from the organism being eaten to the predator. Because the arrow points from dragonfly nymph to brown trout, the predator of the dragonfly nymph is brown trout.
